iti9:1.1: 9 vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatāti me sutaṃ
iti9:2.1: lobhaṃ bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya
iti9:2.2: lobhañca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyāti.
iti9:4.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
